name: vl-estoque
description: Sistema de gestão de estoque — V&L Mercadinho e Panificadora

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n banco,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db -w @vl/api" "npm run dev -w @vl/api" "npm run dev -w @vl/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vl/web && npm run build -w @vl/api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n banco,app -c blue,green "npm run db -w @vl/api" "npm run start:prod -w @vl/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vl/api && npm run typecheck -w @vl/web
